title: How Aura works
description: What Aura is, the daily rules, how to give it on Explore, what creators see, and common blockers—short how-to, not the long brand page.
content:
Aura is scarce daily recognition you give to hubs on Explore so stronger work can rise. This page covers the rules, how to give it, what creators see, and why you sometimes can’t.

Primary action: Give Aura on Explore · Creators: check Analytics on your hub.

What Aura is

Aura is community endorsement for hubs—not money, crypto, or a star-rating system. You spend a small daily budget on hubs you find worth learning from. That signal can help quality show up on Explore.

Philosophy and longer answers: How Aura works or the full Aura guide.

The rules

  • 5 Aura per day — your daily budget to give.
  • Resets at midnight UTC — you get 5 again even if you used all 5 already.
  • Hubs only — not people or profiles.
  • No self-Aura — you can’t give Aura to your own hubs.
  • Give and take back — you can remove Aura you gave (as the product allows) to free budget for somewhere else. Aura already on a hub stays until you remove it; daily reset is only a fresh budget to give, not a wipe of past endorsements.
  • Split or focus — put all five on one hub, or split across a few.

Daily budget and streak

  • You get up to 5 Aura each day. Your budget resets at midnight UTC.
  • Put all five on one hub, or split across a few. Choose carefully—your daily budget is small on purpose.
  • You can remove Aura you gave to free budget for somewhere else. Given Aura stays until you decide otherwise.
  • Giving and taking Aura is how the library surfaces quality as community signal on Explore—not a paid ranking guarantee.

Longer philosophy: Aura guide.

How to give Aura

  1. Sign in at app.kahana.io.
  2. Open app.kahana.io/explore.
  3. Find a hub → use the Aura control on the card or hub surface.
  4. Confirm your remaining daily budget before you leave.

Anyone with an account can give Aura. You don’t need a hub of your own first.

What creators see

  • Aura counts and who gave (as shown on marketplace cards).
  • Aura in hub / creator Analytics.
  • Signal only—not Kahana’s official endorsement of the hub.

Common blockers

SymptomLikely cause
Can’t giveNot signed in, or no budget left today
Error on your own hubSelf-Aura is blocked
Don’t see Aura on a hubHub isn’t listed, or you’re not on an Explore surface that shows Aura

Listing help: List a hub on Explore.

Aura vs paid access

Aura does not unlock paywalls or replace purchases. Paid hubs still need Stripe checkout (or trial rules where offered). Buyers: Buying & access. Creators: Turn on paid access.

Quick facts

  • Daily limit: 5.
  • Reset: midnight UTC.
  • Auth: giving requires a logged-in member.
  • Target: hubs only; no self-Aura.
  • Not: money, crypto, star ratings, or guaranteed Explore rank.
